name: Q3 2026 Seattle return request.eml
subject: HANGS General Contracting Q3 2026 Seattle business tax return
body:
Hello,

Attached are the Q3 2026 billing register by city and the Q3 general ledger for HANGS General Contracting LP. The Seattle account details, the job list, the Q1 and Q2 Seattle returns, the state returns for July to September and the invoice for change order 6 on Pier 9 Lofts are in the shared folder.

We missed the October 31 due date for the Q3 Seattle return while I was out. Please prepare it now as a draft for review; we will file and pay it ourselves in FileLocal. It is separate from the state returns we file in My DOR.

Duwamish Gateway sits across the Seattle and Tukwila line. Our project manager thinks about 60% of the work was on the Seattle parcel, but we do not have a survey split or a cost split yet, so everything was coded to Seattle.

We wrote off the Fremont Bakehouse balance (invoice HGC-25-0917) on September 30. That invoice was reported as Seattle revenue on our Q4 2025 Seattle return.

Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS General Contracting
